coverageNotes: X08 gap-fill: 19 of the 20 named companies placed, 20 Bengaluru offices. None of the 20 was already in the dataset under another name (checked every raw file's names and aliases). LEFT OUT: Games24x7. Its own contact page still lists a 'Bangalore' office with only a phone number and email, The New Indian Express reported it would shut the Bengaluru office from 6 Sep 2025 after the Online Gaming Act ban on real-money games, and no street address could be found. The only address found was a one-off hackathon venue in Mahadevapura, which is not evidence of an office. CATEGORY CHANGES FROM THE CRITIC'S LIST: Strand Life Sciences is MID_SIZE because it was incorporated in 2000, before the 2005 startup cut-off, and is now ~80% Reliance-owned. Paytm Money is MID_SIZE because it is a wholly owned subsidiary of listed One97 Communications, not a venture-funded startup. The parent One97/Paytm (HQ Noida) is NOT entered, because no Bengaluru office of the parent itself was substantiated. Urban Ladder and Zivame stay STARTUP: they were founded after 2005 and venture-funded before Reliance bought them. CONFIRMED FROM COMPANY PAGES: Strand (MSR North Tower, also the MCA address as of Mar 2026; the hinted Kirloskar Business Park in Hebbal is an older address, no longer listed, and is left out rather than pinned), iD Fresh (corporate office via its contact-page map pin, plus its Attibele plant), Eightfold (SJR Cyber), Paytm Money (The Hub), Cropin (privacy policy and T&C), MyGate (footer plus OSM POI), HomeLane (contact-page schema), BlueStone (investor-relations page), Observe.AI (careers page: IndiQube Lakeside, not the Prestige Khoday Tower or IndiQube Lexington addresses that directories list), SUN Mobility (site footer) and GIVA (contact page). SECONDARY OR WEAK: Locus. A profile gives Novel Tech Park, Kudlu Gate. Locus's own schema markup still says Mayur Greens, Koramangala, but that address is commented out of its visible office list, so Novel Tech Park is used at medium. MediBuddy: IBC Knowledge Park is certain, but the tower is not (C per Craft/Bitscale, D per CB Insights, and D is Medi Assist's published corporate office); the OSM 'Medi Assist' POI in Electronic City belongs to the insurance-TPA parent and is not used. Harness: HSR Layout address from one job listing. HackerRank: its About page confirms a Bangalore office but gives no address, so it is pinned to the OSM 'Hackerrank' POI in Koramangala. Hasura: low. The Koramangala 80 Feet Road address comes from a directory plus a now-removed 2022 Hasura page, and the company has since pivoted to PromptQL. Snitch: registered address from the LEI record and Instafinancials. Urban Ladder: undated CB Insights and Craft HQ listing in Domlur, with post-Reliance status unconfirmed. Zivame: low, because directories conflict (Embassy Prime in CV Raman Nagar, Nov 2025, vs an older Indiranagar address). COORDINATES: several points are street- or locality-level because the building is not in OSM and Nominatim returned HTTP 429 midway. Their offices are capped at medium and the evidence names the geocodeSource. No headcounts were published for Bengaluru, so all are null; Harness's ~250 is India-wide (June 2024).
